name: Aerogel
description: The lightest solid material, aerogel is 99.8% air trapped in a nanoporous silica (or carbon, or polymer) matrix. Its thermal insulation properties are unmatched — a centimeter of aerogel blocks more heat than a meter of fiberglass. In 2200, aerogel insulation is standard in spacecraft, cryo-storage, and Tier 4+ building envelopes.
